mapper.select: SELECT p.PAYMENT_NO, p.USER_ID, p.PRODUCT_NO, p.PAYMENT_METHOD, TO_CHAR(p.PAYMENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PAYMENT_DATE, p.PAYMENT_PAY, p.PAYMENT_BILLING_KEY, p.START_DATE, p.END_DATE, p.STATUS, pr.PRODUCT_NAME FROM PAYMENT p JOIN PAYMENT_PRODUCT pr ON p.PRODUCT_NO = pr.PRODUCT_NO WHERE p.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY p.PAYMENT_DATE DESC
